status_semantics: No field named status. Written before any sampled source image is opened.

sampling_frame.started_from: rows classified INSIDE_SEALED_B1 in the established paired subset
sampling_frame.excluded_detail: 2 class-1 rows and 24 rows of the preregistered class 2 and 3 union; all 26 were deliberately risk-selected and may never contribute to a population estimate

sample_size.target: 95 percent confidence, absolute margin of error at most 0.03

stratification.why: observable before any image is inspected, historically meaningful, and unaffected by later reading
stratification.allocation: proportional, resolved by largest remainder so the parts sum exactly to n

selection.seed_origin: full commit identity of the frozen pre-sampling repository state, supplied by the owner
selection.score: SHA256(seed | source_page | row_id), ascending, first n_h within each run

per_field_states_preserved_separately: RA and DEC each recorded as confirmed, error or not established. A correction is never inferred from cadence where the source image does not establish the value.
primary_measures: P(coordinate error AND B1 membership remains correct)

additional_measure.measure: P(coordinate error | B1 membership remains correct)
additional_measure.caveat: Its precision depends on the observed denominator and is not guaranteed by the sample size above.

estimation.per_stratum: observed proportions with Wilson 95 percent intervals
estimation.overall: p_hat = sum_h (N_h/N) p_h, with stratified design-based finite-population variance for the primary interval
estimation.explicit_prohibition: An ordinary Wilson interval must NOT be applied to the weighted stratified total and labelled design-correct.

preregistered_secondary_analysis: Outcomes reported by DEC-frequency band, page-hit-count band and run, without changing the primary estimator. The 26 previously reviewed rows remain external and may appear only as a separate risk-selected comparison group.

scope_boundary.applies_to: established-paired, currently classified inside B1, previously unreviewed rows
does_not_establish: error rate on the 138 RA_COLUMN_UNRESOLVED pages
error rate for the complete Ohio SETI archive
error rate in the PHL/Arecibo private dataset
correctness or incorrectness of Arecibo Wow! II
